reason: I already run my follow-ups and lead routing through Zapier and HubSpot, and 'AI co-workers' sounds like another layer on top of what I've built. I might poke at the free plan, but I'm not paying 99 a month until I see it do something my current stack can't.
objection: I don't have time to set up and learn another tool, and '100 credits' tells me nothing. I don't know what a credit buys or whether it really plugs into HubSpot and Zapier properly or just says '...'.
would_change_my_mind: A published integration list with a native HubSpot and Zapier/Make connector, plus a clear 'one credit = X actions' table, so I can see in a 15-minute demo that it saves me hours a week.
